feeding_claim.verbatim: Our Cows and Lambs are exposed to only fresh green pasture and hay that we grow on our land.

notes: Feed page says pigs, chickens and turkeys eat feed made by an Amish farm in Dover and get daily pasture access. Beef, poultry and contact pages hit an https to http redirect loop or server error and could not be read. Town of Seaford comes from directories, not the farm site.
